summary: feat(auth-client): report Fastly WAF blocks to Sentry [FXA-14054]
description:
Because:
 - A WAF rule that blocks real users only leaves a Sentry breadcrumb,
   so nothing is queryable or alertable.

This commit:
 - Captures a grouped "Fastly blocked request" Sentry message on
   406/429 responses with a non-JSON body.
 - Reports each status and route once per client to bound event volume.
 - Replaces recovery key and passkey IDs in the route tag.
